evidence: Source review of all 108 criterion descriptions (86 Functional, 14 Polish, 6 Visual, 2 gates) found no instance that enumerates a full-credit bar and then waives its owned requirements. The actual frozen workbook Quality Checks row 34 defines check 33 as one full-credit bar; its Internal Quality Checks row 34 allows shared flows. The skill reference at quality-checks.md:138-140 identifies incompatible targets, while current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md requires independent credit for distinct promises. Under frozen task/tests/, functional/judge.toml:137 requires every named compensation figure in a populated together-view and explicitly permits scrolling while keeping numerical accuracy separate; the arithmetic criteria at :218-254 supply their own unambiguous bars. Its routing checks at :119 and :128 exclude settlement arithmetic without waiving successful targeting. Its relocation checks at :380, :434 and :479 each require a successful relevant operation and absence of relocation postings, including on the stated equivalent fallback setup; no dead-handler absence credit is allowed. The potentially broader-looking exception in functional/judge.toml:200 remains consistent: invalid date inputs cannot create an offer or alter stored dates, and an economic-only revision may ignore an injected date only while preserving valid stored dates. Readback at :785 consistently compares actual saved values; restart at :794 still requires fresh writes and all recorded data after the actual tool restart. Polish/judge.toml:122 allows two ways to observe the same retained-input/recovery outcome and never grants credit for unavailable tool evidence; :140 similarly preserves the pending-state observation requirement. Visual/judge.toml:24-104 has one 5-point full-credit anchor per property, with explicit ownership boundaries. Gate constraints/judge.toml:23-26 consistently requires both newly created records and independent Auditor readback; excluding advanced economics never waives that creation/storage bar. Adversarial textual checks: a broken app whose compensation panel omits approval-band basis while showing the other figures still fails :137; arithmetic ownership cannot excuse the missing field. An app with a dead revision handler cannot pass relocation-revision :434 on absence of payment rows because successful changed-input revisions are mandatory. A conforming alternative with a vertically stacked scrollable breakdown, semantically equivalent labels, and economic-only revisions that ignore extra date fields satisfies the stated bars without imposing extra layout/date-edit requirements. No conflicting target emerged. All 11 current raw-evidence-index artifact hashes and their listed frozen-source hashes matched; index SHA256 b677af1218def2fca64e5d64aa3d810f633edf4587c951f6eda17a82a995050d. No runtime observation is cited for this semantic row. No app/provider/Docker execution was performed, and this row makes no configured-judge, Oracle, model-score or portal-clearance claim.
